title: Vacation/Staycation - Hot Tub, LGBTQ, Fire Pit
description:
Our home is a 3 Bedroom, 2.5 Bath, relaxation destination. Featuring a spacious backyard with six person hot tub, fire pit, hammock, and covered pavillion. There are four bicycles also available for use.

We are located one mile from downtown Nashville/Broadway, and are a short walk to Germantown, Brooklyn Bowl, Sounds Stadium, The Gulch, and Marathon Village. 

Free street parking is available in front of the house.

We believe that Black Lives Matter, No Human is Illegal, and Love is Love.

Guest access
The entire home is yours, including the backyard and hot tub. You will have a personalized door code for the front door.

Other things to note
Any tobacco use inside of the home will result in a minimum $1,000 fine. Full house cleanings for smoke are ~$5,000. 
Seriously, this is a major undertaking. 

We are happy, fun, loving people. We enjoy sharing our home with you during your stay in Nashville. We equally enjoy returning.
